outgoing.name: Internet
outgoing.excerpt: Napster was the first widely-used peer-to-peer (or P2P) music sharing service, and it made a major impact on how people used the Internet.

outgoing.name: Music
outgoing.excerpt: John Titor, a purported time traveller from the year 2036, says that Napster is still distributing music in his time.
